cycle_time.basis: Represents the logged status-heartbeat interval reported to a SCADA/historian layer, not the internal safety scan rate (dedicated safety logic solvers scan in the 10-50ms range per IEC 61508/61511 practice -- a reaction-time requirement, not a logging-cadence one, and a different quantity from what is modeled here). No safety-domain-specific standard specifies a logging CADENCE for safety-status reporting to a historian, so no such citation is claimed. 5s is informed by common SCADA/OPC-UA historian logging conventions, which place trending-type data in a 5-10s band and routine equipment status/diagnostics in a 30-60s band (both well above sub-second critical-value polling and well below the internal safety-scan rate); 5s was kept at the tighter end of the trending band given the safety relevance of the underlying sensor. This is disclosed as an industry-practice-informed assumption, not a citable domain-specific figure -- it should not be presented in Table D1 with the same evidentiary weight as the Step 1 robot cycle-time figures.
